a.title: App Eng. accountable; FDE code review

Brownfield and modernisation: BRD Builder, PRD Builder and Jira Backlog Manager are optional when approved artefacts already exist; Context Builder and everything from Spec-Clarify onwards still apply.

Legend: □ Core agent ■ Custom (SCBx) agent ■ human reviewer and decision. Supporting agents (Compliance Reviewer, Context Updater, Figma Extractor, Technical Documenter, Traceability Manager) run at the gates and between stages.
